children: jumped 2.7% in Tuesday's trading following a Bloomberg report that the U.S. Department of Energy will offer as much as $5B in financing to the company to upgrade and modernize its fleet of nuclear reactors in Illinois, Maryland, and Pennsylvania.

Energy Secretary Chris Wright will announce the funding through the DoE's Office of Energy Dominance Financing later Tuesday at an Illinois nuclear plant that will supply power to Google, according to the report.

reportedly is planning investments at six Illinois plants—Braidwood, Byron, Clinton, Dresden, LaSalle, and Quad Cities—as well as Calvert Cliffs in Maryland and Limerick in Pennsylvania to increase production from existing nuclear plants.
The projects backed by the conditional loan commitment are expected to add nearly 1.1 GW of electricity and help strengthen the grid and lower costs.
